name: Bounded public-source research report
unit: One authorized report-job admission during the pool window

input.sourcePolicy: Buyer supplies public-source text and its original URLs; no authenticated browsing or purchases.

output.citationPolicy: Link factual claims to supplied sources; distinguish inference from source statements.

validation: Input eligibility and output acceptance are off-chain buyer/provider policy. The prototype does not validate documents, run an agent, or attest quality.
delivery: Admission occurs in the pool window. The market's settlementDeadline is separate from the admission window.
commitment: serviceHash is keccak256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of this file, including its final newline.
